merger_description:
The transaction involves the acquisition of joint control over US NewCo LLC, an entity to be established (the **Target**), that will at closing own, directly or indirectly, all of the issued and outstanding equity interests in the entities comprising the Loparex operating group (**Loparex**) by entities and funds affiliated with Monarch Alternative Capital LP (**Monarch**) and by funds managed and advised by affiliates of GASC APF, L.P. (together with its affiliated investment funds **GA** and, together with Monarch, the **Acquirers**) (the **Acquisition**).

The Acquisition forms part of a broader financial restructuring of Loparex's capital structure, involving a refinancing and recapitalisation of substantially all of Loparex's outstanding funded indebtedness and equity.

On completion, funds affiliated with Monarch and GA will indirectly hold equity interests in the Target.

Monarch is a global credit and real estate investment firm with approximately $17 billion in assets under management, with offices in New York, Florida and London.

GA is a global growth investor with more than four decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 520 growth companies. GA manages approximately USD $129.9 billion in assets under management as of 30 June 2026 with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across 5 regions.

Loparex is a manufacturer and provider of release liner and technical film, headquartered in the USA.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition given there is no horizontal overlap or
vertical relationship between Monarch or GA and Loparex in
Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
